title: Theo and the Salt
author: Kestrel Blackwood
blurb: Ada Joubert, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
